description: This file contains extension methods for document objects in the MigraDoc library, providing functionality to retrieve elements, recursively traverse document object trees, filter by type, and extract text content, styles, and formatting details.

classes.name: ElementsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for working with DocumentObject instances in MigraDoc, including element retrieval, filtering, and text extraction.

methods.name: GetElements
methods.description: Retrieves child elements or sections of a DocumentObject, optionally including headers and footers.

methods.name: GetElements<T>
methods.description: Retrieves child elements of a specific type T from a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetElementsRecursively
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all descendant elements of a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetElementsRecursively<T>
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all descendant elements of a specific type T.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a collection of DocumentObject instances to only those of a specified type T.

methods.name: GetText
methods.description: Extracts the concatenated text content from a collection of DocumentObjects or specific elements like Cell, Paragraph, Hyperlink.

methods.name: GetStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style name of a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the ParagraphFormat of a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the Font used by a DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetUsedFormatValue
methods.description: Retrieves a formatting value (e.g., size, font) either directly or via style inheritance, optionally for Font or ParagraphFormat.
